newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-YEGOROVA BEATS VIALBE TO 5-KM GOLD.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-YEGOROVA BEATS VIALBE TO 5-KM GOLD.

text.p: Olympic champion Lyubov Yegorova won gold in the 5-km classical event at the Nordic skiing world championships on Sunday as Russia continued to dominate the women's cross-country races.
Yegorova clocked a winning time of 13 minutes 29.90 seconds, beating fellow Russian Yelena Vialbe into second place.
Vialbe, who won the opening 15-km freestyle race on Friday, was leading after 1.8 km but she was 2.8 seconds slower than Yegorova on the line with a time of 13:32.70.
Stefania Belmondo of Italy took third place with 13:35.00.
